about: First-cut LADOT-style crash profiles for SF, built by analysis/crash-profiles/crash-profiles.py from out/crash-augment/tables (DataSF ubvf-ztfx, 8gtc-pjc6, nwes-mmgh).

rules.test: one-sided exact binomial on KSI crashes vs citywide (or the mode's) KSI crash rate, Bonferroni over cells tested; a cell is tested when it holds MIN_INJURY_CRASHES injury crashes

size.about: people hurt (any injury) and KSI people by group, sorted by people hurt; no size floor, no test

other_breakdown.about: what size.chart's last row and the catch-all values hold. Catch-all values: violation other and not stated, movement not stated or other, mode not stated, and crash type Other and Not Stated

by_catch_all.kind: violation not stated + movement not stated or other
violation other + movement not stated or other
violation not stated + mode not stated
violation not stated + movement not stated or other + mode not stated
movement not stated or other + mode not stated

all_crashes_by_catch_all.kind: violation not stated + movement not stated or other
violation other + movement not stated or other
violation not stated + mode not stated
violation not stated + movement not stated or other + mode not stated
movement not stated or other + mode not stated

regroupings.name: now: mode x movement x violation
finer codes: mode x movement x violation
crash type in place of movement: mode x crash type x violation
crash type beside movement: mode x crash type x movement
family, current violation groups: mode x violation
family: mode x violation (finer codes), chosen for size_families

size_families.about: people hurt and KSI people by mode x violation family (VIOLATION_FINE), each with its people by movement; chart is the union of the FAMILY_TOP biggest families by people hurt and by KSI people, then one row over every other crash (mode not stated included), so the rows add up to the totals
size_families.violation_code_fallback: when vz_pcf_group is blank or Unknown, vz_pcf_code is read if it holds a section number

family_stress.about: the FAMILY_STRESS_TOP biggest size_families by people hurt, split by the bike level of traffic stress of the crash's most stressful block (high is LTS 3 or 4) and by street class; segment_crashes_share is the high-stress share among crashes placed on one block, which carry no lean toward the intersection's busier street

grouping_alternatives.about: other groupings of everyone hurt, scored as in other_breakdown.regroupings, each with its top CHART_BARS bars. A person grouping counts victims rows with any injury (age outside 1 to 109 is not stated); a crash grouping counts each crash's people. Catch-all values: not stated, unknown, other, Other, Not Stated, the movement and time not-stated values; victim role Other is named as scooter or other

groupings.name: who was hurt: victim role x age band
place: traffic stress x street class x intersection or midblock
time: mode x time band x weekday or weekend
hybrid: vehicles only by crash type, pedestrian and bike by violation family
who and what: victim role x violation family
hybrid with movement: vehicles by crash type, pedestrian and bike by violation family x turn
what and where: mode x violation family x traffic stress
speed limit: posted speed limit of the crash's street
lanes: number of lanes on the crash's street
light: daylight, dusk or dawn, or dark
equity: in an Equity Priority Community
vehicle weight: the heaviest vehicle's weight band
